title: Confidential City Meeting Announced
summary:
*   Austin city leaders convened a special meeting solely to publicly announce their immediate move into a closed-door executive session.
*   The private session was authorized by state law (Article 6252-17, Paragraphs e, f, g) for confidential discussions.
*   Officials assured the public that any final actions or decisions resulting from the executive session would be announced in a subsequent open meeting.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS-
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
June 19, 1975
11:00 Α.Μ.
Council Chambers
301 West Second Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Friedman presiding. Roll Call: Present:
Councilmembers Himmelblau, Hofmann, Lebermann, Linn, Trevino, Mayor Friedman, Mayor Pro
Tem Snell Absent: None
1
Mayor Friedman announced that this was a Special Called Meeting of the City Council for
the purpose of publicly announcing that during the meeting it will convene in a Closed or
Executive Session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f), and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed or executive
session, any final action, decision, or vote with regard to any matter considered in the
closed or executive session would be made in open session, should such action, decision or
vote be necessary.
Mayor Friedman announced that the Council would go into Executive Session at this time to
consider the items authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs
(e), (f), and (g) of Article 6252-17.
